title: Purity Quad – Chrome
description:
Most people think having a small bathroom means living without a spacious shower. The Aquaglass Purity is a spacious enclosure that doesn’t comprise the size of your space. It uses the same amount of floor space as standard enclosures but comes with an extra-tall height for a feeling of openness as you shower. Smooth roller wheels and magnetic seals support the frame and doors, while an easy-grip doorknob prevents slipping in the shower. It’s even finished in our signature Aquashield coating, which smooths crevices in the glass to make the panels easier to clean.
Please note: images depict quadrant enclosures only and have been used to illustrate any offset enclosures.

title: Frameless 2 Door Quad – Chrome
description: There’s nothing worse than a shower door that sticks. Luckily, the innovative 2-in-1 design of the Aquaglass Frameless is an easy-open enclosure that heightens the elegance of your bathroom. Instead of having roller wheels built inside the frame, they sit on a cut-out panel at the top, providing you with a silky smooth gliding action and greater control during use. Its statement look also makes a great focal point in bathrooms, making it perfect for adding style to downstairs shower rooms. Best of all, it can also be installed without a shower tray, giving you a stylish showering option for wetrooms.

title: Aquaglass Sphere 1 Door Quad – Chrome
description: Not every shower enclosure has to have D-shaped handles. So, if you love ingenious design twists, the Aquaglass+ Sphere is the perfect choice. The circular shape is comfortable to hold and features a polished chrome finish for a better grip while opening and closing. The sliding door also features a unique rolling action that makes it easy to open, so you don’t have to worry about accessibility for younger family members. Our signature Aquashield finish has been added to ensure this enclosure’s easy to clean.
